bench_e2e.description: Default three-repeat 2/4 Gbp E2E comparison: all-SIMD CPU, all-GPU, and minimap2 cells in both cold no-index and cold just-index modes. Bioseq no_index loads base target data untimed with every minimizer sidecar absent, restarts PostgreSQL, then times transient index construction + mapping only. just_index prebuilds the index untimed, restarts PostgreSQL, then times cold index read + mapping. minimap2 keeps its CLI build+map/map-only semantics.

bench_e2e_signoff.description: Five-repeat sign-off 2/4 Gbp E2E comparison with the same exact all-SIMD CPU, all-GPU, and minimap2 cells and cold-index semantics as bench_e2e.

bench_e2e_gpu_batch_validation.description: Focused non-rejection comparison for the selected all-GPU path. One physical bioseq target joins a bounded query table through BioseqBatchJoin; target bytes are never duplicated to manufacture a batch. The GPU row is accepted only when the Vulkan batch branch is taken, CPU/SIMD fallback rows are zero, Vulkan declines are zero, and every query maps correctly.
